home.h1: The Choicer Voicer online — play in your browser
home.lead: Searching for The Choicer Voicer online or in the browser? Dubmates is an independent dubbing game you can play here: pick a pack, record clip by clip, export a video. Not the official TCV site — built for the same “grab a mic and dub a scene” energy, without installing a desktop app.
home.whatTitle: What Dubmates is (and how packs work)
home.whatBody: Dubmates is a voice-over / dubbing game you play in a browser tab. You load a pack, listen to how each line is delivered, then record your own version over the scene. When every clip has a take, you watch the finished dub end to end and download it.
home.whatResult: A pack is a timed scene: video (or frames), dialogue windows, and usually original prompt audio — often the same idea as community Choicer Voicer / Dub Mode ZIPs on GameBanana. Packs may keep a backing track so music and effects still play under your voice.
home.whatShare: On Dubmates you can start with a ready pack on this page, or import a Choicer Voicer–format ZIP. Text mode follows the original lines; Impro keeps the timing while you invent new words. Takes stay local — we don’t upload your voice.
home.s1d: Hit Play for a featured scene, browse the catalog, or import a Choicer Voicer–format Dub Pack ZIP from GameBanana / choicervoicer.com. Keep it zipped.
home.s2d: Play the original line (Text mode) or preview the video window (Impro) so you lock the timing before you speak.
home.s3d: Press Dub and perform. Stop early if you’re done, or redo the same clip anytime — you don’t have to restart the pack.
home.s4d: Your take draws over the reference so you can see if you drifted early or late. Replay My take synced with the video.
home.s5d: Finish the pack, watch the full dub, check the Text-mode score if you want, then download MP4 (best for sharing) or WebM.
home.micBody: Dubmates needs microphone permission to record. Browsers only grant that over HTTPS. If you blocked access earlier, reopen the site permissions in your browser settings, then try again.
home.micBody2: Solo takes stay in this browser (IndexedDB on your device). Pack ZIPs, videos, and original prompt audio are not uploaded to Dubmates. Export your video before clearing site data if you want to keep it.
home.browserLead: Recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari all work — on desktop and on mobile. A few notes worth knowing:
home.browser1: The page must be served over HTTPS, or microphone access is blocked.
home.browser2: Private / incognito windows sometimes refuse local storage, so imported packs or takes may not persist.
home.browser3: Some community packs use OGV video decoded in JavaScript when the browser lacks native support — that can feel slower on older phones.
home.browser4: Headphones help a lot: open speakers can bleed the original audio into your take.
home.browser5: Keep this tab in the foreground while exporting. Switching apps or locking the screen can pause rendering and produce a glitchy or wrong-length video.
home.whyTitle: Why play here instead of only watching guides?
home.why1d: This isn’t just an article about The Choicer Voicer — the studio is on this page.
home.why2d: Open Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari, allow the mic, and start. No desktop client.
home.why3d: Import community Dub Packs in Choicer Voicer format, or use the packs we already host.
home.why4d: Recordings stay on your device. Great for party nights without uploading takes.
home.scoreLead: After you finish a pack in Text mode, Dubmates gives a quick grade — coverage, timing, and energy. It’s feedback, not a talent show judge like a desktop host panel.
home.scoreCoverageD: Did you record enough clips in the pack?
home.scoreTimingD: Is your take roughly as long as the line window?
home.scoreEnergyD: Did the mic catch a present voice — not near silence?
home.scoreNote: Impro mode turns scoring off on purpose: absurd rewrites are the point.
home.cvTitle: The Choicer Voicer online vs Dubmates
home.cvBody: Dubmates is not affiliated with The Choicer Voicer and is not an “official online version.” People still search those words because they want to dub scenes in a browser — right now — without hunting for a desktop install or fighting mic quirks on a local app.
home.cvAlt: If that is you: play Dubmates here. Same pack-friendly idea (including Choicer Voicer–format ZIPs), clip-by-clip recording, and a video you can download. Different product, same urge to perform.
home.faqTitle: FAQ — The Choicer Voicer online & Dubmates
home.faq1q: Is Dubmates the official The Choicer Voicer online?
home.faq1a: No. Dubmates is an independent browser dubbing game. We don’t claim to be the official TCV site or the official online version.
home.faq2q: Can I play something like The Choicer Voicer in my browser here?
home.faq2a: Yes. Open Play on this page: dub a ready pack clip by clip, or import a community Dub Pack ZIP and record over the scene.
home.faq3q: Do I need to install an app?
home.faq3a: No. Dubmates runs in a modern browser. Allow the microphone when prompted and you’re in.
home.faq4q: What packs work — including Choicer Voicer format?
home.faq4a: Use our hosted packs, or import Dub Packs with a dub video (Choicer Voicer–style ZIPs from GameBanana or choicervoicer.com). Only packs with dub_video.ogv-style media are supported for import right now.
home.faq5q: Is there a score like the judge panel?
home.faq5a: In Text mode we give a simple coverage / timing / energy grade after the pack. Impro mode has no score — it’s for funny rewrites.
home.faq6a: Allow the mic when the browser asks. If you blocked it, reopen site permissions in the browser settings. Headphones help so the speaker doesn’t bleed into your take. Keep the tab in the foreground on mobile.
home.faq7a: Locally in your browser on this device. They aren’t uploaded to Dubmates. Export your video before clearing site data.
home.faq8q: Can I invent my own lines?
home.faq8a: Yes — switch to Impro: keep the scene timing, change the words. Often the most shareable results.
home.faq9q: Why does export take a while or look glitchy?
home.faq9a: Export re-renders the scene with your takes in the browser. Keep this tab open and the screen unlocked until it finishes. Leaving the tab can cause stutter or the wrong length — just run export again.

howto.title: How to play Dubmates
howto.metaDescription: Full guide: start a pack, dub clip by clip (Text or Impro), learn the studio controls, the score, then export your video.
howto.lead: Dubmates is an online dubbing game: mic + a modern browser, and you can make a funny video to share. Here’s the detailed walkthrough.
howto.need1: A mic (built-in or headset) and browser permission when it asks.
howto.need2: Headphones if you can: the speaker can bleed into your take.
howto.need3: A modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari…).
howto.s1d: On the home page, click Play. The featured pack loads. You can also Choose a pack or Import a ZIP (compatible Dub Pack).
howto.s2d: Above the waveform: Text (follow the original lines) or Impro (invent your words while keeping the scene’s rhythm).
howto.s3d: For each line: listen or preview the scene, record your voice, replay your take, then move on until Finish.
howto.s4d: At the end: watch your dub, see the score (Text mode), download MP4 for social apps or WebM for a quick local file.
howto.cModeD: Text shows the line and original waveform; Impro hides the original text (you invent) and turns off scoring.
howto.cHearD: In Text mode: replay the original line with the video timing. Useful before you dub.
howto.cPreviewD: In Impro mode: replay only the video window (no original voice) so you can lock your improv.
howto.cRecordD: Starts mic recording for the clip length (+ a small buffer). Stop cuts early if you’re done.
howto.cTakeD: Replay your last take on this clip, synced with the video. Don’t like it? Dub again.
howto.cNavD: Move between clips. Finish (last clip) opens the result screen. The dots under the buttons show clips you’ve already dubbed.
howto.cWaveD: Red / gray: original reference (Text mode). Blue: your take. While recording, the live level follows the playhead.
howto.cExtraD: Change packs, import a ZIP, go fullscreen, or return to the start screen without leaving the site.
howto.scoreLead: Text mode only, after you finish the pack. Quick feedback — not an artistic judgment.
howto.score1: Coverage: share of clips that have a take.
howto.score2: Timing: is your take roughly as long as the line window?
howto.score3: Energy: did the mic catch a present voice (not near silence)?
howto.scoreNote: In Impro, no score: we prioritize fun and absurd lines.
howto.tip1: Allow the mic on the first prompt; otherwise reopen the site permissions in the browser.
howto.tip2: You can redo a line without starting over: Dub again on the same clip.
howto.tip3: At the end, download the video before clearing site cache: takes stay local in the browser.
howto.tip4: Impro + scene timing often makes the funniest videos to share.
howto.tip5: Keep the tab in the foreground during export.

legal.aboutMeta: Dubmates is an independent browser dubbing game: record over scenes, import community packs, and download your video — free, no install.
aboutParagraphs: Dubmates is an independent online dubbing game. You pick a scene pack, record your voice clip by clip in the browser, then watch and download the finished dub.

We are not affiliated with The Choicer Voicer or any desktop “official” product. People often search for Choicer Voicer online because they want to dub scenes without installing software — Dubmates is built for that browser-first use case.
You can play packs we host, or import community Dub Packs in Choicer Voicer–compatible ZIP format (for example from GameBanana). Recordings stay on your device; we don’t require an account to start.
Dubmates is made for fun with friends: party nights, absurd Impro takes, and shareable clips — not for hosting a library of copyrighted movies or TV shows.
legal.contactMeta: Contact Dubmates for product questions or copyright notices. Email contact@dubmates.org or copyright@dubmates.org.
contactParagraphs: Questions about the product, packs, or this website? Send us a short message. We read every note, though replies may take a few days.
For copyright or DMCA-related requests, use the copyright address below and include the page URL, a description of the work, and your contact details.
legal.privacyMeta: How Dubmates handles mic access, local takes, and analytics. Recordings stay on your device by default.
privacyParagraphs: Dubmates records your voice in the browser when you choose to dub. In solo mode, takes are stored locally (IndexedDB) on this device so you can replay, finish a pack, and export a video.
We do not upload your audio to Dubmates servers to play, review, or download. Clearing this site’s data in your browser deletes local takes.
No account is required to use the core game. We use Google Analytics (GA4) to measure product events such as page views or button clicks — never your voice recordings.
The browser may ask for microphone permission. You can revoke it anytime in your browser settings. Imported ZIP packs and their videos also stay in your browser unless you export or delete them.
If you contact us by email, we use that message only to respond and handle the request.
legal.termsMeta: Terms for using Dubmates: entertainment use, imported packs, consent, and acceptable behavior.
termsParagraphs: Dubmates is a dubbing game for entertainment. You use the service at your own risk and are responsible for how you use exported videos.
We do not provide a library of copyrighted movies or TV shows to dub. Hosted demo packs and community packs you import are your responsibility to use lawfully.
Do not record another person without their consent. Do not use Dubmates for harassment, hate, illegal content, or to infringe someone else’s rights.
Imported Dub Packs remain subject to the rights of their creators and any platforms that host them. Respect those rights when you import, dub, and share.
The exported video file on your device is yours to keep; that does not grant you rights in third-party video or audio you did not create.
We may update these terms as the product evolves. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated terms. The service is provided “as is” without warranties of uninterrupted availability.
legal.dmcaMeta: How to send a copyright notice to Dubmates. Contact copyright@dubmates.org with URL, work description, and your details.
dmcaParagraphs: Dubmates does not offer a browsing library of copyrighted films or series for dubbing. Players may import their own community packs; we do not claim ownership of that third-party material.
If you believe material made available through Dubmates (for example a hosted pack page or linked listing) infringes your copyright, send a notice to the address below.

Please include: the URL or pack identifier, a description of the copyrighted work, your contact information, a statement of good-faith belief that use is not authorized, and a statement under penalty of perjury that the notice is accurate and that you are authorized to act.
After a valid notice, we will remove or restrict the material within a reasonable time where applicable.
